reviews.title: Too many bugs
reviews.text:
I like that I can stream high quality audio and that Tidal pays artists more than other streaming services but the app does frustrate me. 

The most annoying thing is that when the app has to buffer because the connection speed isn’t good enough, it frequently gets stuck and will never restart. Sometimes you can skip to the next song and get it to play again. Other times you just have to close the app and restart. It happens a lot. 

Just recently I discovered that Tidal is saving files to a cache and my phone had 76 Gb of junk and there isn’t an easy way to get rid of them. You either delete one file at a time, which could take hours, or delete the app and reinstall. 

If people at Tidal are using their own app, I would think they would have addressed these issues by now.

reviews.title: Better service than the green app, but buggy
reviews.text:
Tidal feels about a decade behind its major competitor which is actually *unironically great* - I'm not having a load of rubbish pushed in our faces, sound quality is good, etc and I'm very glad to be with Tidal. 

But this is an app review and I have to mention the app... 
which is also about a decade behind in stability. In my first year with the service I've reported multiple app bugs (particularly with CarPlay, good grief) AND filed simple artist data corrections, and guess how many have been fixed? Yep, zero. Not a sausage.

So what in the name of Godspeed! are you actually doing with your updates each fortnight, just moving UI controls around? That's what it feels like.

reviews.title: Good ethics, poor functionality
reviews.text:
I switched to TIDAL because I like the compensation they offer for artists, and their stance on AI.  We pay for a family plan. But that app doesn’t always work correctly. With an up-to-date and “ healthy” phone it still has the following issues. 

1. Will not save any recent searches under the search bar for later reference. My wife’s does. But mine doesn’t. 

2. Shuffle activates on its own. Which is frustrating when you’re listening to an album, or playlist that you curated the order on.

3. With full signal, the songs will cut out and start loading like it’s searching.

4. There are times that you can pause and leave the app shortly, and go back, and it starts to track over again instead of picking up where you left off.

reviews.title: App is poor
reviews.text: Has anyone at Tidal actually ever tried to use the app in the car? It’s horrendous. The albums are sorted vaguely in the order you added them, so it is impossible to find the album you want, especially whilst driving. You can select an artist alphabetically, but then it plays all tracks across all albums in alphabetical order, i.e. not by album. It’s a joke. The sound quality is good, but the app is not fit for purpose. It’s been like this for years and all these problems are well aired on the internet, they simply can’t be bothered to fix something simple that would make it vaguely useable. If I was starting again I’d just get Spotify

HOWEVER, the bugs and glitches were too damn much: no song nor playlist can play through when you first open the app. You have to troubleshoot 1-2x every time you want to play music. reviews.title: Really not thought out for iOS
reviews.text:
Tidal is great on pc, but there are so many issues on iOS. The tidal website confirms the only way to empty the cache is to delete the app! That's bonkers levels of useless. My phone almost completely stopped working because Tidal will simply eat into any available storage without warning. I only found out because I went into iphone storage to see what was wrong. Putting "this is expected" on the help page doesn't excuse the terrible design. It's not sustainable to have downloaded music creating huge and eternal cache files.

On a smaller note, albums that should be gapless aren't, which is conspicuous considering that Tidal is so into listening experience. There are a few other small bugs but the cache issue is sort of an app killer for me.

reviews.title: Very poor user experience
reviews.text:
I downloaded TIDAL as I wanted to get off Spotify, but after a couple months of trying to use this app I unfortunately am going to have to return to Spotify. 

The offline download functionality is completely broken, which is incredibly frustrating when you get on a plane and realize your offline music isn’t actually available to listen to. When you download music on Spotify it is reliable and saves instantly.

TIDAL also lists all artists with the same name under one entry which is a horrible design choice. If you try to shuffle the music under a given artist’s profile you get a combination of random songs from other genres, plus terrible AI songs pushed under the artist’s name in order to steal revenue from the artist you’re actually trying to listen to. You need to tap into individual albums and EPs by the artist to actually exclusively hear music by the person you’re looking for, but this is a big pain if you’re tapping into EP after EP to queue up the one song in each album (and even then, you have to figure out which albums are real and which are AI).

Given the higher price point of the subscription relative to Spotify I would expect at a minimum the same level of functionality. Considering how long this service has been around for I’m surprised at the basic issues this app faces.

reviews.title: Popsuta aplikacja
reviews.text:
Jestem rozgoryczona… Nie chciałam dawać tak mało gwiazdek, ale zostałam zmuszona… 

Od bardzo dawna aplikacja ma problem z tym, że na kontach wielu artystów pojawiają się utwory cudzego autorstwa lub co gorsza - piosenki AI wrzucone przez randomowe osoby. Wiem, że jest to problem wszystkich aplikacji muzycznych, ale wiem też, że na Tidalu jest to bardziej uciążliwe, bo to aplikacja trzeciej kategorii (po Spotify i AppleMusic) i nikt nic z tym nie robi.

A od miesiąca pojawiło się MNÓSTWO błędów, które uniemożliwiają korzystanie z aplikacji. 

Zaczęło się od tego, że nowe wydania zaczęły się pojawiać z datami wstecznymi (np. album z 1.05.2026 był podpisany jako opublikowany w październiku 2025). Piosenki nie pojawiały się więc w aktualnościach… absurd.

Potem doszedł problem z tym, że w albumach pojawia się tylko część utworów (np. 5 zamiast 13).

A teraz na nowo opublikowanych albumach pojawia się błąd i nie odtwarza części utworów. 

Frustracja we mnie narasta z każdym dniem. To brak szacunku dla subskrybentów i artystów. Zróbcie coś z tym.

Na koniec dodam, że odtwarzanie offline to koszmar. Znalezienie tej opcji jest tak mega nieintuicyjne, że powinniście dać jakiś poradnik/mapę dla nowych użytkowników jak to znaleźć. Ja musiałam użyć poradnika z internetu…

reviews.title: Offline and downloads still don't work properly

Tidal itself is fine. The iOS app has had issues with downloads and offline / poor signal detection since I started using it a few years ago. Downloads in particular are hopeless, really unreliable, and seem to need a level of signal stability which can't be relied on out in a city. 
Carplay integration also needs work although at least the black screen until the app is opened on the phone has been fixed. Navigation is poor - can't get to artist page or album from the currently playing track and generally hard to browse. Often end up stuck listening to the same albums on a long journey as there's no way to break out of the Home Screen options or what is in collection. It’s not like tidal is cheaper than the alternatives so not sure why these things go unfixed.

So many of the other negative reviews are at least in part download / offline related and the only response from tidal is to 'contact support'. Come on, put the work in, you only have to fix it the once and the complaints will go away.

Because of this I switched back to the dreaded Apple Music.  First-starting a song has a long lag, and it’s not just my phone or connection.  Lots of complaints about this on Reddit.  Second-the repeat song function doesn’t work.  Sometimes it works, sometimes it doesn’t.  Again-lots of users reporting similar issues for years with no fix.  Third-switching songs has an extreme lag that many users also experienced across a range of devices, and connectivity.  Lots of other small bugs that are easily fixable but have been ignored.  It almost feels like the developers decided to release the app and never check back on it.  Many of these have no excuse to still be issues as they should be easy to fix.  If they fix their app and bring it up to modern day as far as options and speed I will switch back, but until then it’s just irritating.

reviews.title: This app doesn’t even deserve a single star
reviews.text: Save your money. I’ve been using tidal for months now and you’d think that improvements would have been made in that time. You’d be wrong. In fact the app has gotten worse. Spotty Bluetooth connections, tracks failing. You want to remove a track from your playlist? Too bad because you can’t, but they’ll randomly add some absolutely terrible song from some obscure artist and it’s quite literally never a good song. If you want to listen to a song on repeat? You can’t. It’ll play once and stop, then twice and stop again and you have to restart the song from inside the app or it will not start again. Your playlist will be stopped because a track you just listened to suddenly isn’t supported anymore, except that’s not even true. They waste your time, your money, and it’s incredibly frustrating. They say updates will come but they don’t and they won’t. You’re better off with SoundCloud and that’s really sad. A so called high quality streaming platform never ever working ever with absolutely zero fixes to it? I have issues with it everyday. It’s so bad I don’t even really listen to music anymore because I don’t want to deal with the coding disaster that tidal is. This app was constructed by amateurs. No professional worth their reputation would ever let their work be this bad for as long as it’s been.

reviews.title: Frustrating
reviews.text: Tidal is great in so many ways, but why do software developers change basic good features? The new toolbar at the bottom of the screen is to my mind too bulky, it hides a fair amount of the screen, and where has the option to go back a track gone? Why change this? Also, there seems to be a thing where if you’ve chosen shuffle on a previous playlist or album, the next time you play another playlist or album it’s still on shuffle. Is it possible this can be changed? Very annoying feature. And idk about anyone else but I swear that sometimes Tidal adds playlists or radio stations on my behalf, just coz I happened to listen to them or venture towards certain tracks. I’m also not sure if this is happening or not, but it seems sometimes when I like an album then ALL the tracks get added as favourites, which of course they aren’t. I’d appreciate a developer response to this please, and advice on how to change settings if that’s all it boils down to.

reviews.title: Issue with family plan
reviews.text:
I’m told it works well with a subscription, but unfortunately I can’t comment on that myself due to an issue my family have run into with the family plan system.

I was invited, and the website told me that I was not in the same country as the person that created the family plan. I absolutely am.

Because it never requested my location, I assumed it was basing it off of my IP, so I turned off my VPN and had it tried again, but an “unexpected error” kept occurring.

I find it odd that you even need to be in the same country, as there’s a finite number of accounts you can extend the family plan to, it does not clarify this restriction anywhere I can see on the description of the family plan.
Regardless, if a VPN is enough to mess it up, I don’t understand why there wouldn’t be an option when it believes you’re in a different country to tell it you have a VPN and have it check again after you turn it off, instead of what I’ve ended up having to do, deleting the account and making a new one with the VPN turned off from the start.
My child’s father is currently busy and cannot try again, but when he is able to we shall see if this has been enough to fix the issue.
